purpose: Define candidate exclusion classes and bind historically exposed development records to prevent development leakage into v1.4 evaluation.

v13ReplayCohort.policy: All 30 candidates from the historical v1.3 retrospective replay cohort are development-exposed and strictly ineligible for future independent v1.4 evaluation.

sevenSemanticFalseNegatives.policy: These exact seven records were inspected in failure taxonomy construction and must not be used as independent evidence of semantic improvement.

fourTechnicalAblationCandidates.policy: These four candidates were failure-enriched and inspected during the technical ablation, rendering them ineligible for independent semantic evaluation.

developmentFixtures.policy: Any candidate previously used in unit tests, prompt development, or manual verification fixtures is strictly ineligible. No candidate may become evaluation-eligible until P2 reconciles all prior manually inspected/test/development candidate IDs into a complete exclusion ledger. The generic developmentFixtures policy is not itself proof that all fixture IDs have been enumerated.

prospectiveHoldoutFirewall.policy: The prospective semantic holdout is strictly sealed and must never be accessed, read, parsed, or evaluated during retrospective development.

evaluationEligibilityRules.rule1: Candidates must be drawn from unexposed retrospective editorial tranches.
evaluationEligibilityRules.rule2: Candidates must have accepted human adjudication (DEFECT_POSITIVE or CLEAN).
evaluationEligibilityRules.rule3: Evaluation cohort must contain exactly 30 DEFECT_POSITIVE and 30 CLEAN records.
evaluationEligibilityRules.rule4: Defect-positive cohort must include at least 6 severe defect cases.
evaluationEligibilityRules.rule5: Selection must be deterministic from an eligible pool using a preregistered random seed.
evaluationEligibilityRules.rule6: P1 does not select or inspect any evaluation candidate.
